It is worth gathering the closure announcement, the receipts for what you bought and dated screenshots of your account, library and progress. If it is software, the invoice, the licence and the packaging also matter, because the law requires them to state how long the version sold will work.
What can still be asked when the end is unavoidable?
The closure affects all users at once. That is why it is the kind of case in which bodies such as Procon, the Public Defender's Office and the Public Prosecutor's Office can act.
<1>What can still be asked when the end is unavoidable?</1>
1. It can close the business, but that right does not include erasing everything without any care for those who were inside.
2. What you bought only works while someone keeps the servers on and the environment standing.
3. Photos, histories, libraries, contacts, progress, reputation and years of investment go with it, and they do not become worthless just because they are stored in another company's structure.
What can you demand from whoever arranges the shop window?

When the same unclear criterion of ordering or reputation affects everyone who buys there, the response can be collective. Procon, Consumidor.gov.br and the Public Prosecutor's Office are the paths for this.
<1>What can you demand from whoever arranges the shop window?</1>
1. In an online store with many sellers, the so-called marketplace, you choose among what the platform put up front, with the badges, ratings and highlights it organises.
2. It chooses what appears first, what stays hidden, who seems trustworthy and what can be compared.
3. When the same company arranges the shop window and also profits from what happens in it, the situation becomes more serious.

The essential thing is to record how much you paid in reais for each pack, the balance you had and the price in coins of the items that matter, before and after the change. The company's notice also deserves to be kept, because a major game's contract promises to give notice when a change affects the currency negatively and significantly.

First of all, the complaint goes to the company itself. The contract that says the currency is non-refundable makes an exception for when your consumer rights guarantee a refund. So the answer does not stop at what is written there.

A change to the currency affects everyone with a balance at the same time. That is why it is the kind of case that can go to Procon, the Public Defender's Office or the Public Prosecutor's Office. In these cases the response can target the whole rule, and not just your balance.
1. You bought internal currency with real money, such as a game's coins or an app's credits, and now the same item costs more coins.
2. The company that sells the currency is the same one that sets prices inside, which is why the change must be looked at carefully.
3. Each currency works like a language of its own, and you are the one who has to translate everything.

Ranking is the order in which the platform shows offers or people. Some examples are an unclear punishment policy, changes that leave no trace and a ranking that decides everything without a usable history. They also include the screen that hides the essential in too much information and the customer service that absorbs the complaint before it becomes a dispute.

The collective response can seek measures that stop the loss from continuing and make the service checkable from then on. These include keeping minimum records, giving a verifiable reason for relevant punishments, keeping an accessible history of changes and explaining the minimum criteria of distribution, priority and ranking.
1. The same problem hit many people in the same service, and each person stayed on their own, thinking it was bad luck.
2. The cases do not need to be the same, because what repeats is the source of the problem.
3. The sign is a single origin, which repeats and is part of the service's normal way of working.

At the same time, outside stores sold the game's currency as something safe and advantageous, and nobody made clear what was official, tolerated or forbidden. So it cannot be presumed that anyone would know how to tell legitimate resale from fraud with a cloned card.
What can you ask to get back?
The request may also include that the company state clearly where it is safe to buy and that it stop applying rules that place the whole risk of fraud on the buyer.

The first request goes to the company itself, with what you kept about the origin of the items. If the only answer is that the terms of use allow removing the content, Procon, Consumidor.gov.br and the Small Claims Court are the next paths.
Reports from other players help show the picture, but on their own they do not prove what happened. And asking is not the same as getting, because each case depends on what can be proved.
<1>What can you ask to get back?</1>
1. You received an item as a gift through the game's official feature, and later it disappeared from your account because there was fraud somewhere along the way.
2. What is usually behind it is the chargeback, which happens when someone disputes the card purchase and the bank reverses the payment.
3. Whether the feature was official matters a great deal.

The strongest sign is the combination. Urgency is highlighted, while the limits of use, the chance that the item will change and the possible losses stay in the background. And you do not need to prove that anyone meant to rush you.

It is worth recording the screen with the time remaining, the limited-edition notice and the offer as it appeared, with the date. It also helps to note when the same campaign or the same last chance came back, because repetition shows the urgency was the store's routine.

For passes and events, the event rules, the goals with deadlines, the announcements of what would come and the changes made midway are useful. With them you compare the promise at the start with what was delivered at the end.
What to ask for when the purchase was pushed by urgency?

The request can start with information. When the store uses intensity and scarcity to hurry the decision, it must show the essential right there, at the time of purchase, prominently, in a comparable way and at the right moment.

If it does not resolve things, it is worth taking the case to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court. Since manufactured urgency is usually the store's routine, and not just your case, it calls for a response for everyone, either through a collective action or through the public consumer protection bodies.
<1>What to ask for when the purchase was pushed by urgency?</1>
1. The countdown, the limited edition or the notice that the item would disappear made you decide quickly, perhaps before understanding everything you were buying.
2. A digital item could be sold to everyone, at any time, without running out.
3. Urgency is highlighted, while the limits of use, the chance that the item will change and the possible losses stay in the background.
What can you demand from the company about this program?
If it does not answer or if the program damages your equipment, there are Procon, Consumidor.gov.br and the Small Claims Court.
<1>What can you demand from the company about this program?</1>
1. Fighting cheating is legitimate, but the word security does not end the discussion about how far the company can command your machine.
2. It starts when the computer starts, and the company can block the game if it is turned off or removed.
3. The question is whether this interest is enough for the company to gain so much power over your equipment without stronger control.

The central evidence is the advertising pieces, the previews, the store screens with what was highlighted and the purchase and confirmation screens, with dates. It also helps to record what happened afterwards, to compare the earlier promise with what you could use.
What can you demand when delivery fell short of the advertisement?

If the company does not correct it, the complaint goes outside it, to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court. When the same advertisement reaches many people, the response can go beyond your case and change the communication itself, through a collective action or through public consumer protection bodies.
<1>What can you demand when delivery fell short of the advertisement?</1>
1. The offer is what the company commits to delivering when it advertises.
2. You bought after seeing previews, countdowns, rarity badges or promises of prominence, and what came afterwards does not match what all of that led you to expect.
3. A loose, enthusiastic phrase, with no weight in your decision, is not enough.

The strongest tools, such as the order to show documents and a different division of the work of proving, work inside a lawsuit. That is why, when the evidence is all with the company, it helps to have a lawyer or the Public Defender's Office, and the Small Claims Court also takes this kind of case.
1. That is why the work of proving can be divided according to each side's access, without excusing you from telling coherently what you went through.
2. The company knows what it showed you, when it showed it, which version was in force, which transaction took place and which rule it used in a punishment.
3. When all of that stays only with it, whoever controls the service also comes to control the evidence.

Conversations with customer service are evidence, as are the canned answers and the justifications the company gave. It also helps to note the steps you were led through, such as waiting, trying again or accepting a vague explanation, because they show how the loss was handled.

When the conversation with the company just goes round in circles, it may be better to take the complaint outside it, to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court. Waiting for customer service itself to acknowledge the loss can leave the problem unanswered, since the company also influences the moment the loss becomes visible.
1. Customer service is kind, answers quickly and asks you to wait, but the problem continues, and you end up letting it go.
2. The answer seems to explain, but does not say what happened, and the tone is friendly, but no path of challenge opens.
3. It is whether customer service works in a way that diverts the reading of the loss and weakens your complaint.
